About A1 Gallery · Curated website design inspiration

name: A1 Gallery
summary: Curated gallery of 1,000+ websites, broken down into sections and interior pages, with fonts and templates.
description: A1 Gallery is a curated web design inspiration gallery: full-length captures of 1,000+ websites, browsable by type (agency, landing page, portfolio, shop), category, style (big type, dark, minimal, animated, illustration, 3D) and technology (Framer, Webflow, Next.js, Astro). Each site is broken down into page sections (hero, pricing, footer, testimonials, FAQ) and interior pages, and an MCP server serves JSON search, filters and measured design tokens. Free to browse; Pro ($72/year) adds higher MCP limits, analytics, unlimited saves and full-page screenshots.
contains: browse by type, category, style and technology
page sections carry measured colour palette, type stack and spacing
MCP server for JSON search, filtering and per-site detail
font index: Inter (256 sites), Geist (84), Geist Mono (70)
templates, designer profiles and OG images sections
